title: Mera Jhoole wala Asghar
body:
mera jhoole wala asgher
batlaade mujhe aye beta ab kaise jiyegi madar
nazuk se gale par teer laga aur zulm ka phir khanjar bhi chala
duniya me koi maa meri tarha
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhe na kabhi ye manzar
ye kaisi qayamat aayi hai
khaime me udaasi chhayi hai
tum sote ho beta sehra me
<<DIVIDER>>
bechain hai dukhiya madar
gehware me karwat le le ke
wo dekhna mujhko hasrat se
tadpata hai dil ko shaam-o-sahar
<<DIVIDER>>
khush hoke humakna dilbar
hai ghair sakina ki halat
har lamha masaeb ki shiddat
ab aao bulaati hai beta
<<DIVIDER>>
roro ke tumhari khwahar
tum jab se gaye ho aye beta
dushwaar huwa maa ka jeena
har lamha musibat aati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
har saans me hai ek mehshar
jab hogi kahi'n majlis barpa
jab jhula tumhara utthega
dene ko duwa lene pursa
<<DIVIDER>>
maa jayegi beta ghar ghar
chhe maah me aye goudi ke pale
nusrat ke liye baba ki gaye
manzar thi yehi madar ki sada
<<DIVIDER>>
har saans pa asgher asgher
